items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: I never did know his wife, you know. Much as I played around there for him.

ctx.x: Seems like I heard that. I don't know that. His wife is supposed to be living that today. Yeah? Yeah. She lives in the fence border on Bourbon Street, I believe.

Well, he had so many women around his place all the time. I didn't know one from the other, you know. I never did know his wife, you know. Much as I played around there for him. Because he was well liked by the women folks, you know. Of course, he was a big sports, you know. And he had all kind of fine women there in his place.
Did he have rooms upstairs for them?

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Anderson, Tom Anderson, uh, is the biggest place I know the way they played at.

ctx.x: You wouldn't know, you knew both those guys, though.

Yeah, I know both of them, yeah. But he was a guitar player, and he'd sing and entertain, you know. Charlie. Yeah, yeah. And, uh, uh, Anderson, Tom Anderson, uh, is the biggest place I know the way they played at. Mm-hmm. Uh, uh, Walter Preston, and Tom Brown on a mandolin, well, he played mandolin like I was playing, and, uh, uh, Charlie Washington on a guitar, too. They had another fella played guitar called Snow. His nickname was Snow, but I never did know his first name. We used to call him Snow. They had two…
And that's all you ever knew?

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: I was going to ask a couple of questions like about Tom Anderson when you played for him.

ctx.x: Take Rene and Rene's band. Rene had his wife, she had a big book, a record book. And she would take dates while he'd be out. They'd ring up. And she'd see Marvin on the book. Yeah. This was my job, different places, all from different around here. We have just about another minute or two on the show. We have just about another minute or two on the show.

We have a job for every night and week. We have just about another minute or two on here and we won't bother you anymore. But I was going to ask a couple of questions like about Tom Anderson when you played for him. Where did you play? Where did you play? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
